description: Locate and index a Strapi project on demand from an ABSOLUTE path — either the project root, or any file/folder inside it (the server walks up to the project root; a folder is also scanned downward for monorepos). Use this when a tool returns `noProject`. Idempotent. Returns the projects now known (use a name/root with `from`/`project`).

path.description: Absolute path to the Strapi project root, or to any file/folder inside it.

name: add_project
title: Register a Strapi project by path
